title: We automated
our own posting
for about £58 a month
slides.subtitle: A daily content job that took over an hour now runs as a draft we approve. Here is what it does, what it costs and where it still needs us.

slides.label: The problem
slides.detail: Daily posting took too long and the results were inconsistent. Different tone on different days, a missed day when things got busy, and over an hour of work every time we did it properly.
slides.start: Time one week of your own posting. Count every step, not just the writing.

slides.label: What we built
slides.detail: A daily routine that picks a topic, researches it, writes the blog post and the captions for each platform, makes the illustrations and a short video, then publishes everywhere in the same brand, theme and style.
slides.start: Write the steps of your own routine down first. You cannot automate what you have not described.

slides.label: A human still approves it
slides.detail: Nothing goes live on its own. Every morning we review the draft, ask for changes or reject it. Some days we do reject it, and that check is the point, not a flaw.
slides.start: Decide where a person signs off before you build anything. Put that step in on day one.

slides.label: What it costs to run
slides.detail: About £58 a month in tools: Claude £20, Zernio £20, n8n hosting £10, Higgsfield £5, Gemini £3. GitHub is free. These are tool costs only, and your own mix will differ.
slides.start: List the tools you would need and their monthly price before you start, so the bill is no surprise.

slides.label: Time to build
slides.detail: One day for the first working version. We have kept adjusting it since, as the platforms and our own rules changed. Plan for upkeep, because an automation is a thing you maintain.
slides.start: Build the smallest version that works end to end, then improve it in short passes.

slides.label: What changed
slides.detail: Consistent, regular posting, and over 7 hours a week saved. We are not claiming it has grown our following. The honest result is time back and a steady output.
slides.start: Measure hours saved first. Audience growth takes longer and needs its own tracking.

title: Describe the routine.
Then automate it.
slides.body: This is our own system, built for ourselves. Results are ours and will vary for your business and your tools.
slides.cta: Which repeat job in your week takes over an hour and follows the same steps every time?
